instrument: Yellowstone County letter to legislators on the Montana Right to Compute Act
summary: County commissioners drafted a letter asking state lawmakers to clarify the Right to Compute Act to preserve local zoning authority over data centers.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (KTVQ)
